checks.name: factory_presets_exist
command: test -f Resources/Presets/TightMetalQuad.xml && test -f Resources/Presets/WideDouble.xml && test -f Resources/Presets/LooseGarageDouble.xml && test -f Resources/Presets/SubtleThickener.xml && test -f Resources/Presets/LiveQuadTracking.xml

checks.name: preset_masterseed_and_params_present
command: rg -q 'masterSeed' Resources/Presets/*.xml && rg -q 'timingSpread' Resources/Presets/*.xml && rg -q 'pitchSpread' Resources/Presets/*.xml && rg -q 'tightness' Resources/Presets/*.xml && rg -qi 'Live' Resources/Presets/LiveQuadTracking.xml

checks.name: correctness_tests_and_cmake
command: test -f tests/CorrectnessTests.cpp && rg -q 'CorrectnessTests\.cpp' CMakeLists.txt && rg -qi 'binary_data|BinaryData|Presets' CMakeLists.txt && rg -qi 'FFT|fft|pitch|deltaC|2\^|cents' tests/CorrectnessTests.cpp && rg -qi 'corr|rho|width' tests/CorrectnessTests.cpp

checks.name: rt_safety_script
command: test -f scripts/check_rt_safety.sh && rg -q 'ScopedNoDenormals' scripts/check_rt_safety.sh && rg -q 'malloc|juce::String|processBlock' scripts/check_rt_safety.sh && rg -q 'random_device' scripts/check_rt_safety.sh

checks.name: pluginval_script
command: test -f scripts/run_pluginval.sh && rg -qi 'pluginval' scripts/run_pluginval.sh && rg -q 'strictness|VST3|CLAP' scripts/run_pluginval.sh && rg -qi 'LV2|Standalone' scripts/run_pluginval.sh

checks.name: verification_and_manual_docs
command: test -f docs/verification/shreddouble_verification.md && test -f docs/shreddouble_manual.md && rg -qi 'pluginval|mono-lows|seed|ear-pass|manual|tightness' docs/verification/shreddouble_verification.md && rg -qi 'Re-roll|masterSeed|Rate|Tightness|LV2|Tight Metal|Live Quad' docs/shreddouble_manual.md
